forbidden_actions: Do not use shell-inline or inline-code verification commands.
Do not execute install, bootstrap, preview, deploy, or network-fetch commands through the contract.
Do not mutate Vercel, auth, services, or any live/public state.

rules: Report findings first, ordered by severity, with file and line references when available.
Prioritize bugs, regressions, privacy or safety risk, deterministic breakage, and missing verification over style notes.
If there are no findings, say so explicitly and note residual risk or testing gaps.

classification.one_off_judgment: Keep one-off judgment in the review itself.
classification.repeatable_defect: Promote repeatable defects into tests, lint rules, or CI.
classification.missing_domain_knowledge: Promote missing domain knowledge into canonical docs or a reusable skill.
classification.agent_behavior_failure: Promote agent behavior failures into operating evals.

escalate_if: Existing domain instructions conflict and cannot be reconciled without product changes.
Verification requires installs, secrets, unavailable Playwright browsers, or deployment state.
Any action would trigger Vercel or mutate live/public state.
